/* Offline cache for the Home Screen app (generated by src/make_sw.py.txt from src/sw.template.js.txt: edit those, not sw.js).
   Only registered on GitHub Pages; the Claude artifact and the Android app never use it. */
const CORE = __CORE__;
const BIG = __BIG__;
const CORE_CACHE = 'tip-core-__CORE_V__', BIG_CACHE = 'tip-big-__BIG_V__', FONT_CACHE = 'tip-fonts-1';
const KEEP = [CORE_CACHE, BIG_CACHE, FONT_CACHE];
const url = p => new URL(p, self.registration.scope).href;
const bigSet = new Set(BIG.map(url)), coreSet = new Set(CORE.map(url));

async function fill(name, list) {
  const cache = await caches.open(name);
  for (const p of list) {   /* one at a time: gentle on phones; skips what an older cache already holds */
    const u = url(p);
    if (await cache.match(u)) continue;
    const old = await caches.match(u);
    if (old && name === CORE_CACHE) { await cache.put(u, old); continue; }
    const r = await fetch(u, { cache: 'no-cache' });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(p + ' ' + r.status);
    await cache.put(u, r);
  }
}
self.addEventListener('install', e => e.waitUntil(fill(CORE_CACHE, CORE).then(() => fill(BIG_CACHE, BIG)).then(() => self.skipWaiting())));
self.addEventListener('activate', e => e.waitUntil(caches.keys().then(ks => Promise.all(ks.filter(k => k.startsWith('tip-') && !KEEP.includes(k)).map(k => caches.delete(k)))).then(() => self.clients.claim())));

/* core: answer from the cache at once, refresh it in the background */
async function core(req, key) {
  const cache = await caches.open(CORE_CACHE), hit = await cache.match(key);
  const fresh = fetch(req.url === key ? req : key, { cache: 'no-cache' }).then(r => { if (r.ok) cache.put(key, r.clone()); return r; }).catch(() => null);
  if (hit) return hit;
  return (await fresh) || Response.error();
}
async function cacheFirst(req, name) {
  const cache = await caches.open(name), hit = await cache.match(req, { ignoreVary: true });
  if (hit) return hit;
  const r = await fetch(req); if (r.ok || r.type === 'opaque') cache.put(req, r.clone()); return r;
}
self.addEventListener('fetch', e => {
  const req = e.request; if (req.method !== 'GET') return;
  const u = new URL(req.url);
  if (u.origin === location.origin) {
    if (req.mode === 'navigate') return e.respondWith(core(req, url('./')));
    const key = u.origin + u.pathname;
    if (bigSet.has(key)) return e.respondWith(cacheFirst(new Request(key), BIG_CACHE));
    if (coreSet.has(key)) return e.respondWith(/\.(png|svg|jpe?g|webp|ico)$/i.test(key) ? cacheFirst(new Request(key), CORE_CACHE) : core(req, key)); /* images: cached; text: refreshed */
    return e.respondWith(fetch(req).catch(() => caches.match(key).then(r => r || Response.error())));
  }
  if (u.hostname === 'fonts.googleapis.com' || u.hostname === 'fonts.gstatic.com') e.respondWith(cacheFirst(req, FONT_CACHE));
});
